steps.text: Four Years Ago...

steps.name: Theresis
steps.text: Time goes by fast for your race and your country, compared to the Sarkaz.

steps.name: Theresis
steps.text: Not long after the titan that was Gaul collapsed, Victoria and Leithanien feasted on its remnants as quickly and ferociously as they could. It has only been a few dozen years, and the Gallic Era has long since come and gone.

steps.name: Theresis
steps.text: You never witnessed Corsica I's battleships and cannons. You have never knew Lingones's prosperity and pride. The lands of your father's generation have been integrated into the territories of Victoria's most provincial nobles.

steps.name: Theresis
steps.text: The uniform you wear is that of a high-ranking Victorian officer. The medals you wear are all Victorian.

steps.name: Theresis
steps.text: You speak the most standard Victorian as the Londinier nobility do, without even the slightest hint of Gaulish accent.

steps.name: Theresis
steps.text: When you walk before me and claim you want to negotiate with the Sarkaz, what gives you the right to call yourself Gaulish?

steps.name: Lt. Colonel Lettou
steps.text: Your Highness, Gaul has not a single city left.

steps.name: Lt. Colonel Lettou
steps.text: The man who stands before you is not a Gaulish man, but a Gaulish survivor.

steps.name: Lt. Colonel Lettou
steps.text: Some of us live in Victoria, some in Columbia, and some in Leithanien. We did not choose this exile. We've long been without a place to call home.

steps.name: Theresis
steps.text: You wish to rebuild Gaul?

steps.name: Lt. Colonel Lettou
steps.text: Yes, just as you and other Sarkaz wish to rebuild Kazdel.

steps.name: Theresis
steps.text: Two centuries ago, the Gaulish Empire's artillery battalion also surrounded the walls of Kazdel.

steps.name: Theresis
steps.text: And now you will speak of yourself in the same breath as the Sarkaz?

steps.name: Lt. Colonel Lettou
steps.text: Victoria was in that war against Kazdel, too. And from what I heard, the reason you and the Military Commission were able to enter Londinium was precisely because of an invitation from Duke Cavendish.

steps.name: Theresis
steps.text: Then I'm certain you've heard what has become of him.

steps.name: Lt. Colonel Lettou
steps.text: Ten days ago, Duke Stafford stirred up an uprising in Londinium, and Duke Cavendish stepped forward to put a stop to his scheme.

steps.name: Lt. Colonel Lettou
steps.text: The Londinium Defense Forces joined the battle as well. Too bad. Neither Duke Stafford nor Duke Cavendish survived the other's cannonfire.

steps.name: Lt. Colonel Lettou
steps.text: I'm sure you know this better than me. The other dukes are all paying keen attention to Londinium's situation right now. No matter what you are planning to do within the city, you will need a new helping hand.

steps.name: Theresis
steps.text: This is how you will work with the Sarkaz.

steps.name: Lt. Colonel Lettou
steps.text: Correct. As you can see, the Gaulish remnant will fully support all of the Kazdel Military Commission's activities in Londinium.

steps.name: Lt. Colonel Lettou
steps.text: In exchange, we only ask that you return the few Gaulish cities to Gaulish rule in Victoria's forthcoming chaos.

steps.name: Theresis
steps.text: What good is my promise? A nation's destruction has nothing to do with the number of cities it has.

steps.name: Lt. Colonel Lettou
steps.text: I understand that, Your Highness.

steps.name: Lt. Colonel Lettou
steps.text: But... We can't afford to wait for a more opportune time than this.

steps.name: Lt. Colonel Lettou
steps.text: I know a Youth Vanguard. He once served directly under the Gaulish Emperor's Guards.

steps.name: Lt. Colonel Lettou
steps.text: When I met him, he was already sixty-something. However, the Guards had long disappeared during the Battle of the Four Emperors. He never got the chance to become a Vieux Vanguard.

steps.name: Lt. Colonel Lettou
steps.text: He told me about the spirited emperor, their indomitable fleet, and the troops' idle conversations during mobilization. Over the decades, he has always insisted on telling his stories in Gaulish.

steps.name: Lt. Colonel Lettou
steps.text: Now, he lies in a small sanatorium in the Chep Borough of Londinium. I paid him a visit not too long ago, and he has already forgotten how to speak.

steps.name: Lt. Colonel Lettou
steps.text: Even so, whenever he sees Gaulish imperial-style architecture on the telly, his muddy eyes regain their former vigor without fail, and he lifts his spasming hands to clap.

steps.name: Lt. Colonel Lettou
steps.text: He will be gone in no more than five years.

steps.name: Lt. Colonel Lettou
steps.text: The last generation of Gaulishmen who have truly seen Gaul with their own eyes is dying.

steps.name: Lt. Colonel Lettou
steps.text: Your Majesty, you are right. Compared to the Sarkaz, our lives are insignificant. Our memories... cannot be passed on through our blood.

steps.name: Lt. Colonel Lettou
steps.text: When the final witnesses pass away, our memories of Gaul will disperse with the wind like the empire. When that moment comes, Gaul will truly be lost.

steps.name: Lt. Colonel Lettou
steps.text: All we can do is to grasp at the ashes as best we can.

steps.name: Victorian Soldier
steps.text: Ballistae! Fire!

steps.name: Victorian Soldier
steps.text: Hold the sealing layer! Do not let them any closer!

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: These Defense Forces men... A tad bit stubborn, aren't they?

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: Because their leader is still up there.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: These soldiers... really respect their commander.

steps.name: Self-Salvation Corps Fighter
steps.text: Commander, the Sarkaz are here! The Rhodes Island Operators are engaged in battle with them!

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: Back them up. We need to draw the enemy's attention on this facade of a battlefield to the best of our ability. To buy the Doctor time.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: My guess is the mercenaries at Highbury died by your hands.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: War is imminent. Both you and I know it in our hearts.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Ascalon, you were born and raised in Kazdel. The General plucked you from a corpse pile, the Regent taught you to use a weapon, to defend yourself and your homeland.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: But now, at this moment when all Sarkaz must stand together, what are you and those Sarkaz at Rhodes Island doing?

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Are you going to give our information to the Victorians? To... a group of outbloods that once trampled upon Kazdel?

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: You betrayed the promise you once made. You betrayed Kazdel.

steps.name: Ascalon
steps.text: Kazdel is several thousand kilometers from here.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: During the civil war, you chose to become Babel's assassin. I couldn't stop you, nor did I have reason to.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: After all, you were serving Her Majesty Theresa, the sole King of Sarkaz.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: But what do you serve now...? A phantom of the past?

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: The civil war ended long ago, and now even Her Majesty Theresa has returned to our side...

steps.name: Ascalon
steps.text: Four years ago... You were the ones who killed her.

steps.name: Ascalon
steps.text: And now you will sully her death so dishonorably.

steps.name: Ascalon
steps.text: Who's the real traitor?

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: —Urgh!
Ascalon's attack cuts through his Arts.
The two of them have been different since they were small.
He learned much from the General. Swordsmanship, military theory, and how to play political games. Yet Ascalon remains as pure as the weapon in her hand.
On the battlefield, she cannot be swayed by any words. Her eyes always focus on her highest priority target.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Lettou...!

steps.name: Ascalon
steps.text: This blood...
A thick, viscous, blood-red color rapidly seeps out of the ground. It turns into a barrier harder than a wall, dividing Lettou and Ascalon.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Doctor, the drones have detected another squad of Sarkaz fighters closing in on our position!

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: No, not just Sarkaz fighters... That surging red...

options: Have the Corps and our operators keep their distance.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Okay, Doctor.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: It's pretty much going exactly the way you said it would. He's heading straight for the top of the command tower!

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: The vampire's twisted stubbornness is really giving away his movements... I won't be affected by that, will I?

options: How are we doing with the drones?
We gotta pick up the pace.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Good news. This command tower is very close to the city walls. I've already located the best route to the control area.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: The modern communication methods that the Defense Forces are using are much easier to take advantage of than all that witchcraft the Sarkaz use. I went and disguised my drones' identification codes. None of our long distance signals will be jammed, guaranteed.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Though... drones are very fragile. If they get attacked, that's gonna be all our hard work down the drain.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: I just hope that Amiya can stall those guys who really know how put up a good fight up there...

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: You're weak and foolish, Liberi.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: You know a Sarkaz can easily end your life, and you choose not to run?

steps.name: Lt. Colonel Lettou
steps.text: I am the commander...

steps.name: Lt. Colonel Lettou
steps.text: This is my tower.

steps.name: Lt. Colonel Lettou
steps.text: My men... They're all still here.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: Perhaps I should consider cleaning them up first, then.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: Hm? These Arts.... This scent...

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: Ah... I see, the foolish pretender is here.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: This is our first proper meeting, 'King of Sarkaz.'

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I've met you plenty of times before, Vampire.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Countless Self-Salvation Corps fighters sacrificed themselves because of you. I remember all their names, and their lives won't carry any less weight than they deserve just because you look down on them.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: So, what do you intend to do, King?

spans.text: So, what do you intend to do,

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: Will you use that... pitch-black axe of yours to end me?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Caster team, sniper team, join me and tear down his blood defense! No time to lose. Seize the target!
All at once, black lines and bolts dart into the thick, blood-colored layer.
Nothing has changed.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: You disappoint me.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: Cautus, you assume the stance of a warrior, yet you deny the necessity of killing in politics. You are even weaker than Theresa.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: Theresa was a ridiculous one... She tried to have the Sarkaz bow down to our invaders, namely Victoria.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: And the most foolish of her actions was undoubtedly her decision to make you her successor.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Focus fire!

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: What a pointless struggle...
Disperse.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: Hm?
Right before the tide of blood reaches Amiya, it's suddenly sliced apart in one clean cut.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: I see.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: In addition to the assassin who was your vanguard, you brought another servant with you.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: I am Amiya's employee, not her servant.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: Banshee.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: Are you perhaps afraid?

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: You think... by hiding in that shell called Rhodes Island, you can refute your relationship with this counterfeit, and escape Kazdel's judgment on its traitors?

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: Your words are always riddled with falsehoods, Vampire.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: Although only for the time being, I took off my Rhodes Island elite operator uniform the moment we decided to come to Londinium.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: I'm the Lord of the Banshees.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: Wheresoever I speak, there lies the Elegiac Court.
The young Banshee raises his hand.
On his dark-colored robe, his incantations quiver softly like the first drop of dew dripping down under morning sun.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: It is not the crown that I follow.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: It is precisely Her Majesty Theresa's ideals that have driven me this far. You took her life and desecrated it, but you can't extinguish the flame that she lit before our eyes.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: How can someone who has seen daybreak return to an eternal night?
